answer: Social Matters >> Rights & Etiquettes Question ID: 10301 Country: Pakistan Title: MY YOUNGER FAMILY MEMBERS AND RELATIVES CALL ME BY THE NAME OF "LAI" MEANING - BIG BROTHER. MY WIFE ALSO CALLS ME BY THAT NAME TOO. SO IT IS PERMISSIBLE FOR HER TO DO SO?? Question: MY YOUNGER FAMILY MEMBERS AND RELATIVES CALL ME BY THE NAME OF "LAI" MEANING - BIG BROTHER. MY WIFE ALSO CALLS ME BY THAT NAME TOO. SO IT IS PERMISSIBLE FOR HER TO DO SO?? Answer ID: 10301 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 99/99=M/1429) The wife should avoid it in future; she should not call you with Lai . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
